integrity: All proof dependencies are mathematical statements in RESULT.md; independent exhaustive color-rule and partition-count code with exact outputs is embedded. These finite computations corroborate but do not prove the infinite-order theorem.
scientific_limitations: The 2012 positive-semidefinite scalar minimum is prior art. This result classifies all forcing sets and their polynomial, for all n>=3; full independent literature-priority audit and external proof review were not performed. The complete 2013 thesis was not inspected.
title: Positive-semidefinite zero forcing of triangular graphs: a forest criterion and complete enumerator
